note: Work that lives outside GitHub: decks, reports, guides, compliance studies, server work, content and data operations. Counted from Claude Code session titles (Nov 2025 onward) plus Canva design files. Client names are intentionally omitted; one session can count in two categories.

categories.title: Analysis, estimation & QA
categories.what: Sizing, auditing and checking work before and after it is built
categories.examples: Man-day estimates for a 5-codebase POS ecosystem · QA / PM reports per module · repository audits & development reports · billing, pro-rate & commission flow analysis for an ISP ERP · Flutter app test checklist · developer skill review

categories.title: Documentation, guides & training
categories.what: Docs that let clients run what was built on their own
categories.examples: Work-order user guide (PDF) · client hand-over & finalisation guides · system flows per user role · RBAC, ERD & API references · module tutorials & case studies · software-engineering course deck (28 slides)

categories.title: Infrastructure, hosting & incident response
categories.what: Keeping production up on whatever hosting the client runs
categories.examples: IPsec VPN gateway on a hosting panel · MariaDB / Galera dump errors · SMTP delivery on shared hosting · manual git deploys & server-log forensics · SSO group mapping (Authentik) · local-AI / GPU tuning · white-label domain roll-outs

categories.title: Data operations & support
categories.what: Moving, cleaning and reconciling the data that systems depend on
categories.examples: Bulk product imports (3,000+ rows) · lead CSV & SQL client imports into an ERP · student-data reconciliation & duplicate-ID fixes · applicant exports & masterlist syncs · recruitment screening sheet

categories.title: Marketing, content & growth ops
categories.what: Helping brands reach people, not only shipping features
categories.examples: Social-media plans for three brands · writer roster for article production · newsletter & CRM email templates · SEO + generative-engine (GEO) optimisation · event & contact sheets for a members' club

categories.title: Strategy, proposals & pitch decks
categories.what: Turning a goal into a plan people can approve: research, proposals, roadmaps and budgets
categories.examples: CEO pitch from a portfolio review · VR safety-training proposal & internal deck · company-profile presentations · budget plan (RAB) + function audit for a civic super-app · PRD for an admissions email system · AI-companion & agency pitch decks (46 slides each)

categories.title: Government & regulatory know-how
categories.what: Making systems fit Indonesian rules and state platforms
categories.examples: LKPP / INAPROC procurement flows · electronic-system operator (PSE) registration · SIPPT & BIOS government APIs · PDDIKTI reporting reconciliation · tax formats in finance reports & e-procurement · scholarship tuition (UKT) rules · retail price-ceiling (HET) rules

categories.title: Brand, design & event collateral
categories.what: Visuals for clients, hiring campaigns and live events
categories.examples: Hiring posters & social posts for engineering roles · event-venue signage: welcome, zoning & activity boards · company profiles & business cards · product presentation for an online store
